opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub user, collect follower count, top repo (stars, language) and latest post, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username
Press Enter and click 'Users' results filter
Open the matching user profile and note followers
Open the top/pinned repository and note stars and language
Fill body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person plus Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view the Wayback Machine snapshot of their company's homepage for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Open archive.org and enter the company domain
Pick the year and a snapshot date
Read headline text on the archived page
Add a note combining the person's facts and the archived headline
